name: yt-dlp
author: Viboplr
description: Play and download audio and video from YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Vimeo and 1000+ other sites via yt-dlp. Search the web directly with built-in and user-defined web indexers. Replaces the YouTube plugin.

permissionReasons.exec:yt-dlp: Search, play and download from YouTube, SoundCloud and the 1000+ other sites yt-dlp supports
permissionReasons.network:*: Web indexers you add can point at any site, and seek-preview images come from whichever site hosts the video
permissionReasons.playback:read: Check what's already queued, so an assistant's enqueue request skips songs that are already there
permissionReasons.playback:control: Play or enqueue what you pick from yt-dlp searches, or what an assistant asks for

viewHeader.subtitle: YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and 1000+ other sites

binaryDependencies.name: yt-dlp
binaryDependencies.reason: Search, resolve and download audio/video streams from supported sites

binaryDependencies.name: ffmpeg
binaryDependencies.reason: Merge separate video+audio streams and convert audio to the chosen format

assistant.instructions: Play music/video from YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and 1000+ sites via yt-dlp (requires the yt-dlp binary — Settings → Dependencies). Flow: search (deliberate calls only — each one costs a yt-dlp run against the site) → pick a result → play_url with its url. play_url also takes a user-pasted link directly, and a playlist/album URL fans out into its tracks. For 'find this track's video' there is also the fire-and-forget context-menu action ytdlp-watch-video (POST /v1/actions/invoke), which searches by title+artist and plays the top hit in one step.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search YouTube or SoundCloud via yt-dlp — returns candidates (title/artist/duration/url). Slow (a yt-dlp run, ~3-10s). A URL as the query lists what's playable there instead

tools.name: play_url
tools.description: Play (or enqueue) a URL yt-dlp can handle — a video/track URL plays it, a playlist/album/set URL plays all its entries. Streams resolve at play time

video.description: Play as video in the theater (default audio)

enqueue.description: Append to the queue instead of replacing it. Entries already in the queue are skipped and counted in skippedDuplicates
